rows.why: The legal and IP risks of the model's components are mapped: licence terms and provenance of base models, fine-tuning data and third-party prompts or configurations, and the risk of infringing or leaking rights in the model itself.
Internal controls that protect the model artifacts (storage, access, versioning, release of weights) are identified and documented.
API usage and version state are monitored in production for signs of model extraction, copying or unexpected changes to a deployed version.
The model is tested for theft, extraction through the API and tampering with versions, and the results are documented.
Access to weights, prompts and configurations, and changes to model versions, are logged so copying or tampering can be traced to who did it.
Controls such as restricted access, encryption and protected backups are applied to weights, fine-tuned versions and system prompts.
Procedures exist and are followed to respond to and recover from theft, leakage or tampering of the model or its configuration.
A tampered or leaked model version can be withdrawn, rolled back to a trusted version, and access to it revoked.

review.reason: Licence terms and provenance of base models and fine-tuning data belong to Model building and Test, tuning and evaluation data; the Model area is the weights and versions as IP, so the why mixes in other areas' checks.

Repeats MANAGE 2.2 (controls on weights, versions, prompts) in different words, and only asks that controls are identified and documented; LLM-3.3 is about retrieved content and memory stores (Source data), off-topic here.

LLM-3.14 (monitor LLM logging for access to known sensitive data) does not support logging access to weights, prompts and version changes; LLM-8.5 is mostly about user inputs and outputs (Input area); LLM-8.1 or LLM-8.10 would fit better.

LLM-3.3 is about retrieved content and memory stores (Source data), off-topic for protecting weights; LLM-6.8 (role separation for model promotion) or LLM-6.5 (MFA on model registries) would support it.
